explain_task.question: The revised objective increased from 4240.0 to 4400.0. Trace exactly which code changes caused that increase by naming the dropped/forbidden variable(s) and the added constraint family, and tie each one back to the precise `general_parameters.csv` field names/values and the business-brief phrases they implement. Then, using the revised LP relaxation output, identify which revised constraints are binding versus slack (cite at least `demand_2`, one `min_regular_daytime_*`, and `contract_cap` with their slack/dual values), explain the business meaning of the nonzero shadow prices and `y_2 = 4.0`, and state why you cannot linearly extrapolate those dual values to predict the effect of further tightening the daytime regular-coverage rule.
